themes_detail.label: Vendor Enforcement Spike
themes_detail.summary: Vendor enforcement complaints surged to 5 THIS WEEK, a 344% increase over the 8-week baseline average of 1.1 per week (z-score: 3.68), signaling either a concentrated enforcement crackdown or rapid proliferation of unpermitted street vending in Morningside Heights.
evidence: 5 vendor enforcement complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 3.68 indicates statistically significant spike
Spike is current, not historical — emerged within the past 7 days
reporting_angles: Interview street vendors about enforcement actions this week — are inspectors targeting specific blocks or food types?
Cross-check with DOE/Parks/DSNY records: Has a new enforcement initiative been announced or deployed to CD109 this week?

themes_detail.label: Drug Activity Uptick
themes_detail.summary: Drug activity complaints jumped to 9 LAST WEEK, a 140% increase from the 8-week baseline average of 3.8 per week (z-score: 4.04), indicating a possible emerging public safety concern in open spaces or residential areas.
evidence: 9 drug activity complaints last week vs. 3.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Recent spike follows a period of relative stability, suggesting acceleration rather than chronic condition
reporting_angles: Map the 9 complaints to specific locations (parks, transit hubs, residential blocks) — is activity concentrated in one zone?
Interview NYPD precinct commander about whether this reflects increased visibility or increased incidents

themes_detail.label: Street Light Infrastructure Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street light condition complaints exploded to 34 complaints THREE WEEKS AGO, a 467% spike over the 8-week baseline average of 6.0 per week (z-score: 16.88), suggesting a widespread outage or rapid deterioration of street lighting across the district.
evidence: 34 street light complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 6.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 16.88 is the highest statistical anomaly in the dataset
Spike is now 3 weeks old — needs current follow-up to determine if repairs have been made or if crisis persists
reporting_angles: Has Con Edison or DOT completed repairs since the spike 3 weeks ago? Request current street light outage map for CD109.
Interview residents about nighttime safety impacts — have residents reported more street crime or decreased foot traffic since lights went out?

themes_detail.label: Water Quality Complaints
themes_detail.summary: Water quality complaints spiked to 3 THREE WEEKS AGO, a 500% increase over the 8-week baseline average of 0.5 per week (z-score: 5.0), potentially indicating contamination, discoloration, or odor issues affecting multiple households.
evidence: 3 water quality complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Water quality issues pose direct health risk — requires urgent verification of current status
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Department of Environmental Protection: Were there water main breaks, boil water advisories, or contamination reports in CD109 three weeks ago?
Follow up with residents who filed complaints — do they still have water quality issues, or has situation resolved?

themes_detail.label: Dead/Dying Tree Surge
themes_detail.summary: Tree condition complaints jumped to 3 LAST WEEK, a 1100% increase over the 8-week baseline average of 0.2 per week (z-score: 6.35), suggesting either seasonal stress, disease outbreak, or storm damage affecting street trees across the district.
evidence: 3 dead/dying tree complaints last week vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 6.35 indicates statistically extreme spike
Tree die-off can indicate environmental stress, pests, or disease requiring rapid Parks Department intervention
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Parks: What is causing sudden tree mortality — pest infestation, disease, recent weather event, or infrastructure conflict?
Map the three complaints — are dead trees clustered in one area or dispersed across CD109?
